name: Reaching for the Sky
source:
School hasn't gotten any easier, and high schooler Shelby understands that  struggle all too well. Her best friend's nagging advice doesn't help much either.  Through failure after failure, can Shelby's grades and friendships turn around for the better? Watch and find out in this comic book visual novel, where Shelby will be pushed beyond her limits to reach for the skies and her dreams.

[From [url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/reaching-for-the-sky]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
学业从来没有变轻松过半点，高中女生谢尔比对此更是深有体会，而死党喋喋不休的唠叨劝告也帮不上多大忙。在接二连三的挫败之后，谢尔比的成绩与友情能否迎来转机？在这部美漫风格的视觉小说中一探究竟吧——谢尔比将不断突破自身极限，向着蓝天与梦想奋力伸出双手。

[摘自[url=https://activedaydreamer.itch.io/reaching-for-the-sky]itch.io[/url]]
